ast.scope: Lexical source projection; no macro expansion or semantic resolution

cost.scope: The scope-specific cost statement within the invariant-and-cost document; no runtime speed measurement inferred.

obernants.scope: names excludes hash iteration nondeterminism in its returned order. scalar_arg excludes rejecting a nonempty nonscalar solely for its size. NaN dimension excludes a successful dims_args result.

Registry snapshot admits arbitrary overwritten registrations and insertion permutations with same final bindings. Dimensions admit fractional/negative antecedents after floor/clamp and arbitrary skipped char arguments.
get copies a function pointer and does not mutate registry. Invalid missing argument fails before type extraction; no matrix product allocation occurs in dims_args itself.
NaN checked before float-to-usize conversion; +Inf saturates usize. Single-array trailing dimensions compare raw floats to one, multiargument trailing dimensions compare converted usize values.
A single scalar dimension means square, no numeric arguments means 1x1, empty dimension vector means 0x0. default_dim chooses rows unless rows==1; dim_arg absent/empty/char yields None.
Expected O(1) map lookup/insert, sorted names O(K log K); dims extraction O(arguments + trailing dimensions). Casting and downstream shape multiplication are not overflow certificates.
